en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a coastal stone town with narrow streets and historic buildings. In the foreground are multi‑story stone houses with shuttered windows facing a cobblestone square or quay. A narrow alleyway leads inward between the buildings, where a couple of pedestrians are visible. Behind the town rises a hill topped with a large fortress and defensive walls. At the very bottom left of the image the word "Hvar" is printed, identifying the location.
